subcommands.add: Add file contents to the index
subcommands.clone: Clone a repository into a new directory
subcommands.diff: Show changes between commits, commit and working tree, etc
subcommands.fetch: Download objects and refs from another repository
subcommands.merge: Join two or more development histories together
subcommands.pull: Fetch from and integrate with another repository
subcommands.push: Update remote refs along with associated objects
subcommands.rebase: Reapply commits on top of another base tip
subcommands.reset: Reset current HEAD to the specified state
subcommands.stash: Stash the changes in a dirty working directory
subcommands.tag: Create, list, delete or verify a tag object
